jxl.tooltip: JXL - JPEG XL, next-generation image format
jxl.tooltipFull: JXL (JPEG XL) - Most advanced image format, supports lossless and lossy compression, compression ratio better than AVIF and WebP, supports progressive loading, animation, HDR and other advanced features. Recommended for scenarios pursuing ultimate compression and quality

avif.tooltip: AVIF - Modern format based on AV1
avif.tooltipFull: AVIF - Image format based on AV1 video coding, extremely high compression ratio, excellent quality, supported by Chrome, Firefox, Safari and other mainstream browsers. Suitable for Web applications and scenarios requiring high compression ratio

webp.tooltipFull: WebP - Image format developed by Google, compression ratio better than JPEG and PNG, supports lossy and lossless compression, transparency and animation. Good compatibility, suitable for Web applications and daily use

heic.tooltipFull: HEIC (HEIF) - Default format for Apple devices, based on HEVC encoding, high compression ratio, natively supported on iOS and macOS. Suitable for image storage and sharing within Apple ecosystem

ai.smartQualityTooltip: Smart quality prediction: AI analyzes image texture, edges, color complexity and other features to automatically predict the most suitable quality parameter (quality value). Avoids over-compression causing quality loss, and avoids excessive quality causing oversized files. Suitable for scenarios where optimal quality parameters are uncertain
ai.autoOptimizeTooltip: Auto parameter optimization: AI automatically adjusts encoder internal parameters (such as effort, speed) based on input format, target format, image dimensions, etc., to find the best balance between compression ratio and quality. Recommended to keep enabled in most scenarios. Includes Bayesian optimization (automatically enabled when sufficient samples available)
ai.ssimValidationTooltip: SSIM quality validation: After conversion, uses Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) algorithm to compare original and converted images, ensuring quality loss is within acceptable range. If similarity is too low (e.g., <0.95), a warning is logged. Suitable for scenarios with strict quality requirements
ai.videoForAnimationTooltip: Animation to video: When detecting large animated images (such as high-resolution GIFs or long WebP animations), AI will intelligently recommend converting to video format (such as MP4/WebM), which can significantly reduce file size and improve playback performance. Disabling this option will always maintain original format conversion

help.title: ❓ User Guide
help.step1: Select images/videos to convert in Eagle
help.smartModeDesc: Use AI to intelligently predict optimal parameters, automatically select format and optimization strategy.

help.videoModeDesc: Professional manual video encoding, exposing complete low-level parameters (GOP, B-frames, motion estimation, etc.), supports animated image to video conversion.

help.aiExecutionDesc: When all options are enabled, executes in this order:

help.aiStep2: Step 2: 🧠 AI Parameter Prediction - Predict optimal params (quality, distance, speed, etc.)
help.aiStep3: Step 3: 🔧 Perform Conversion - Convert with AI-predicted parameters
help.aiStep4: Step 4: 🔬 SSIM Validation - Validate conversion quality (similarity ≥95%)
help.aiExecutionNote: 💡 Disabled features are automatically skipped, no performance impact
help.tip5: 🎯 Range Convergence: Eagle has powerful search and filter functions, it's recommended to filter files in Eagle first (supports format, size, resolution, tags and other multi-dimensional filtering), then use this plugin for conversion. This approach is more flexible and accurate than filtering within the plugin.
